messages:
claire: Quick heads-up 14e2 opened a tiny migration PR focused on C# + PHP snippets and a minimal GH Actions smoke check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4350
noah: awesome. we don't have many C# examples in the migration docs yet, thanks for adding. can you paste the minimal snippets here so i can sanity-check names?
claire: C# (sync, minimal):
```csharp
using Redwood;
var client = new Client(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_KEY"));
var resp = client.Responses.Create(new { model = "redwood-v2", input = "Short summary" });
Console.WriteLine(resp.output_text);
```
samir: nice. PHP next? keep it 4 lines max.
claire: PHP (minimal):
```php
<?php
$client = new Redwood\Client(getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'));
$resp = $client->responses()->create(['model'=>'redwood-v2','input'=>'TL;DR this']);
echo $resp->output_text;
```
elin: editorial: add a short "breaking changes" bullet calling out: invoke -> responses.create, webhook header rename (X-Redwood-Event -> X-Rwdw-Event), and embedding alias dimension change. link to embeddings migration.
noah: also call out that default client timeout increased to 60s in v2; long-running jobs may need custom timeouts. adding that as a one-liner.
claire: GH Actions smoke check suggestion (single job matrix small):
```yaml
name: docs-smoke
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: curl smoke
        run: |
          curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_KEY }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{"input":"ok"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses | jq -e '.output_text'
```
samir: love the GH Actions snippet. one nit: use `jq -e 'select(.output_text != null)"` so it fails if empty. i'll PR a tiny tweak.
claire: done. also added a short mapping table: old param -> new param (invoke.payload -> responses.input, model alias names + vector dims), placed under "quick mapping" in the PR.
elin: doc-bot flagged a link to /guides/webhooks/old -> should be /guides/webhooks/migration. fixed in branch.
noah: can QA run the GH Actions job against staging after merge? ci-bot: staging deploy scheduled post-merge, will run smoke job automatically if `docs-smoke` present.
claire: assigning reviewers @noah @samir @elin. aiming to merge today if CI green. thanks! :rocket:
